inner.algorithm_claim: single OPEN heap until progress first activates
inner.archive_limit_policy: preserve first overflow point and stop, never silently truncate
inner.archive_scope: encountered_replayed_only; J pruning can hide other nondominated routes

best.J_time_scaled_interpretation: fixed-clock post-observation sum, not exact continuous-time MTTD
best.waypoint_semantics: motion commands; a terminal partial edge may not reach its last waypoint

cache_statistics.byte_counter_scope: retained ndarray payload only; use sampled RSS for total memory
cache_statistics.fixed_scalar_cache: original horizon, tick count and time tolerance values
cache_statistics.scope: fresh caches inside one charged solve; no cross-run reuse

diagnostics.first_time_scope: new generated/replayed candidates only; supplied initial route excluded

policy.key: original guide priority, original insertion serial

diagnostics.snapshot_scope: maintained histogram counters, no full-heap scans; all sampling is charged

inner.guide_role: unchanged coarse-cell ordering only; neither guide nor completion is a bound
inner.initial_route_generation_cost: external historical route; copy and original physical replay included

initial_score.J_time_scaled_interpretation: fixed-clock post-observation sum, not exact continuous-time MTTD
initial_score.waypoint_semantics: motion commands; a terminal partial edge may not reach its last waypoint

inner.pruning_rule: accumulated J >= feasible incumbent J + 1e-10; remaining cost is nonnegative
inner.timing_note: completion_s includes its transition, replay and archive subcomponents; do not add twice

replay.J_time_scaled_interpretation: fixed-clock post-observation sum, not exact continuous-time MTTD
replay.waypoint_semantics: motion commands; a terminal partial edge may not reach its last waypoint
